newsitem.title: TUNISIA: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES DOWN, VOLUME UP.
newsitem.headline: TUNIS BOURSE INDEX CLOSES DOWN, VOLUME UP.

text.p: The Tunis Stock Exchange index on Thursday closed down by 1.04 percent in higher trade, bourse sources said.
The market's 30-share index closed at 582.77 from 587.31 on Wednesday.
Trade volume was 978,000 dinars against 120,000 dinars.
Airliner Tunis Air dropped by 3.75 dinars or 18 percent to 16.19 dinars.
Coca bottler SFBT also sharply down, by 3.55 dinars to 114.82 dinars.
